## Change

Describe the change and subsystem.

## Protocol / compatibility

State whether packet formats, model I/O, hardware pinout or persistent data formats change.

## Security and neuro-privacy

State whether the change affects raw neural data, embeddings, decoded speech, cryptography, key handling, intent gating, zeroization, action routing or actuator commands.

## Evidence

Include tests, synthetic-data reproduction steps and benchmark results. Do not attach real neural recordings or secrets.

## Licensing

Confirm that contributed material is compatible with the license of the target path and that the commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
